class Inventory:
    def __init__(self): self.items={}
    def add(self,n,q): self.items[n]=self.items.get(n,0)+q
    def restock(self,n,q):
        if n not in self.items or q < 0: return
        self.items[n]=self.items.get(n,0)+q
    def total(self): return sum(self.items.values())
